mcp_seo_title: Stocknear MCP Server | Connect Your AI Assistant
mcp_seo_description: Connect Stocknear market data to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Hermes, and other MCP clients.
mcp_hero_title: Bring Stocknear research into your AI workflow
mcp_hero_description: Research stocks, financials, options, analyst estimates, market sentiment, and more without leaving your preferred AI client.
mcp_copy_failed: Could not copy. Please copy the text manually.
mcp_step_1_description: Open your Profile and create a personal MCP token. It is shown only once.
mcp_step_2_description: Use a quick-connect link or copy the configuration for your preferred AI client.
mcp_step_3_description: Ask a market question in plain language. Your client selects the right Stocknear tools.
mcp_quick_description: Open your client with Stocknear pre-filled where supported. Authentication happens after you approve the connection.
mcp_quick_fallback: If a link does not open, use the client guide below and paste the server endpoint manually. Never put your token in an install URL.
mcp_claude_description: Claude's browser connector uses Stocknear OAuth. It does not need your personal MCP token.
mcp_claude_step_1_description: Open Claude Connectors, select the plus button, then choose Add custom connector.
mcp_claude_step_2_description: Enter these values. Open Advanced settings for the client ID and leave the client secret empty.
mcp_claude_step_3_description: Select Add, then Connect. Stocknear OAuth has a separate sign-in from stocknear.com. If this is your first connection, create and verify the OAuth account with the same email as your verified Stocknear Pro account.
mcp_claude_team_note: Claude Team and Enterprise: an Owner must add the custom connector before members can connect their accounts.
mcp_chatgpt_description: Use ChatGPT on the web with Developer mode enabled. You need a Stocknear Pro account and a personal MCP token.
mcp_chatgpt_step_1_description: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Security and login. Scroll to Developer mode and turn it on.
mcp_chatgpt_step_1_alt: ChatGPT Security and login settings with Developer mode enabled.
mcp_chatgpt_step_2_description: Go to chatgpt.com/plugins and select the plus button next to Search plugins.
mcp_chatgpt_step_2_alt: ChatGPT Plugins page with the add button highlighted.
mcp_chatgpt_step_3_description: Enter the values below, paste your personal token, accept the custom server warning, then select Create.
mcp_chatgpt_step_3_alt: New Plugin form configured for the Stocknear MCP server.
mcp_chatgpt_security: Your token is secret. Paste it only into the access-token field—never share it or put it in the Server URL.
mcp_clients_description: Use the exact configuration for your app. Existing MCP servers remain unchanged.
mcp_security_description: Use OAuth or your client's secret and environment-variable support. Never commit a token to a repository.
mcp_verify_description: Restart or rescan your client, then ask it for the latest AAPL quote.
mcp_existing_title: I already have MCP servers configured
mcp_existing_description: Merge the stocknear entry into your existing object. Do not replace the whole file.
mcp_tools_description: The catalog is generated directly from the live Stocknear MCP server, so newly released tools appear here automatically.
mcp_tools_unavailable: The live tool catalog is temporarily unavailable. Your existing MCP connection is not affected.
mcp_examples_description: Describe what you want in natural language. Your AI client chooses the relevant Stocknear tools.
mcp_example_1: Compare AAPL and MSFT revenue growth, margins, and valuation.
mcp_example_2: Show unusual options activity for NVDA today.
mcp_example_3: Summarize COST's latest earnings call and analyst ratings.
mcp_example_4: Which stocks report earnings this week?
mcp_example_5: Find the most shorted stocks with improving financial scores.
mcp_example_6: Give me a market overview with sector performance and sentiment.
mcp_cta_description: MCP access is included with Stocknear Pro. One account works across supported clients.
mcp_profile_description: Use Stocknear market research tools directly in your preferred AI client.
mcp_profile_upgrade_description: Upgrade to generate a personal token. If your Pro subscription ends, all MCP credentials stop working immediately.
mcp_profile_unavailable: MCP account details are temporarily unavailable. Refresh this page before changing access.
mcp_profile_limit: 120 requests per rolling minute · 4 concurrent calls
mcp_profile_token_copy_description: For security, Stocknear will not show this token again.
mcp_profile_confirm_rotate: Generate a new token? Your current token will stop working immediately.
mcp_profile_confirm_revoke: Revoke this token? Connected clients will stop working immediately.
mcp_profile_pro_required: MCP access requires an active Pro account.
